new_statements.identity_note: GLEBO = 'Seaside Grebo' of Cape Palmas = Southern Grebo (sout2826, ISO grj), NOT Barclayville Grebo: p.175 'For Grebo we are fortunate in having the excellent grammar and dictionary of Innes (1966, 1967), works on which I have relied heavily. My own research on the language has been carried out in the United States with a single speaker, Mr. Mlen Too Wesley, who comes originally from Cape Palmas in the "Seaside Grebo" area.' Listed because it is the only open first-hand prosody text in the Grebo cluster and it reports (and doubts) Innes's stress claim that underlies the WALS grb 'lexical stress' coding. | p.9 lists the seven Liberian Grebo clusters after Ingemann and Duitsman, cluster 1 = 'Wedebo and Kplebo' = Barclayville Grebo; but the tone statement p.16 is Kru-wide (group-level statement), and the Grebo data actually used come from other (underlined) clusters plus Tepo and Pie [name in source: Wedebo and Kplebo (Liberian Grebo cluster 1; map 3 'Kplebo'); pages 8-9, 16]
